name: cockpit-ide
description: The IDE for developers who thinks spatially

scripts.build: node scripts/build-renderer.js && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && copy src\renderer\*.html dist\renderer\ && copy src\renderer\*.css dist\renderer\ && copy node_modules\@xterm\xterm\css\xterm.css dist\renderer\
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/build-renderer.js && tsc -p tsconfig.main.prod.json && copy src\renderer\*.html dist\renderer\ && copy src\renderer\*.css dist\renderer\ && copy node_modules\@xterm\xterm\css\xterm.css dist\renderer\
scripts.start: node -e "require('./scripts/version').stamp()" && npm run build && node scripts/launch.js
scripts.dev:watch: node scripts/gen-specgen-hash.js && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "esbuild src/renderer/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/index.js --format=iife --loader:.md=text --watch" "copy src\renderer\*.html dist\renderer\ && copy src\renderer\*.css dist\renderer\ && npx wait-on dist/main/main.js && copyfiles -u 1 node_modules\@xterm\xterm\css\xterm.css dist\renderer\ "
scripts.prod: node -e "require('./scripts/version').stamp()" && npm run build && node scripts/launch.js
